preventionRule: Every build step that can rewrite a registered money-page primary CTA after SEO enrichment must preserve its data-bg-conversion action and page/funnel measurement context.
prevention: The commercial pricing final writer emits data-bg-conversion=frisse-blik on its Frisse Blik CTA.
